{{Short description|Canadian chemist and academic}}
'''André Dieter Bandrauk'''  {{post-nominals|country=CAN|OC|FRSC|FAAAS|FAPS|FCIC|FSIAM}}  (born 20 May 1941) is a Canadian chemist and distinguished academic who is a professor of Theoretical
chemistry at the [[University of Sherbrooke]] in [[Montreal]].<ref name="devoir">{{cite news|last1=Daoust-Boisvert|first1=Amélie|title=De Sherbrooke à Berlin - Quand le temps se mesure en attosecondes|url=https://www.ledevoir.com/societe/science-et-technologie/212472/de-sherbrooke-a-berlin-quand-le-temps-se-mesure-en-attosecondes|accessdate=20 August 2017|work=Le Devoir|date=25 October 2008|language=fr}}</ref>

Born in war-time Berlin, Bandrauk immigrated to Canada with his family in 1951 and has been with the University of Sherbrooke since 1971.<ref name="prix">{{cite web|title=Le lauréat André D. Bandrauk|url=http://www.prixduquebec.gouv.qc.ca/recherche/desclaureat.php?noLaureat=419|publisher=Les Prix du Québec|accessdate=20 August 2017|language=fr}}</ref>

Bandrauk was awarded the status of Fellow in the [[American Physical Society]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=&year=&unit_id=&institution=|title=APS Fellow Archive|website=www.aps.org|language=en|access-date=2017-04-20}}</ref> after they were nominated by their Division of Atomic, Molecular & Optical Physics in 2007,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=&year=2007&unit_id=&institution=|title=APS Fellows 2007|website=www.aps.org|language=en|access-date=2017-04-20}}</ref> for "pioneering theoretical contributions to elucidating intense laser interactions with molecules, including predictions of the existence of new molecules and of enhanced molecular ionization in intense laser fields, and of the usefulness of chirped pulses to control photochemical processes."

He was appointed an Officer of the [[Order of Canada]] in 2012.<ref>{{cite news|title=Le professeur de l'Udes André D. Bandrauk nommé officier de l'Ordre du Canada|url=http://sherbrooke-innopole.com/fr/nouvelles/le-professeur-de-ludes-andre-d-bandrauk-nomme-officier-de-lordre-du-canada/|accessdate=20 August 2017|work=Sherbrooke Innopole|date=1 June 2012|language=fr-FR}}</ref>
